{{Top}}
{{Quote|You've found ore! When processed ore becomes durasteel, which is used to make buildings and defenses strong.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=OreFound.flac|<ref name="SW:GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Ore.jpg|thumb|250px|Ore deposits]]
'''Ore''' was a form of mineral suitable for smelting or processing. It was mined by [[Droid/Legends|droid]] or organic workers from ore deposits, and processed at [[command center]]s or [[ore processing center]]s. The ore could then be processed into [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]].

Ore was found on many [[Planet/Legends|planets]].<ref name="SW:GB" /> Most ores were mined and sold on the same world because of the costs associated with lifting bulk cargoes out of a [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity well]]. Unless no feasible substitutes were available in a region, useful but common ores such as [[Copper/Legends|copper]], [[Iron/Legends|iron]], and [[Titanium/Legends|titanium]] were seldom exported from a planet and only in very rare cases out of a [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Only ores valuable enough to turn a profit after taking into account the transportation costs were shipped to other galactic markets.<ref name="LOTE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ore is one of the resources in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' and its [[2002]] expansion pack, [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']]. The mineral serves an identical purpose as stone in the video game [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Age_of_Empires_II Age of Empires II], being used in the construction of defensive structures and technologies.<ref name="SW:GB" />
